text:
Samir: Heads-up: starting bring-up for model v3.2-lite-q4 on canary. Want a quick sanity check on the rollout-gate config before I flip traffic. Thinking layered gates (latency / mrr / hallucination) with a conservative auto-fallback.
Priya: Layered is good. For MRR use relative delta on our evaluation cohort (treatment vs control) and require a 95% CI one-sided test. Avoid absolute token metrics for this one.
Lena: Also add an embed-drift monitor for longdocs — we saw a few noisy regressions when only token-level metrics were considered. :warning:
Jon: Proposal for automatic fallback: immediate rollback if (MRR drop > 3% AND hallucination rate up > 2ppt) over a short window, OR if latency p95 jumps >50ms. Soft fallback: cap traffic to 10% if small, consistent signal.
Samir: Agree. Drafting a config below — basic idea, can we sanity-check thresholds and windows?
Samir (code): ```yaml
gates:
  - name: immediate-rollback
    conditions:
      - metric: mrr_delta
        comparator: "<"
        threshold: -0.03
        window: 5m
      - metric: hallucination_rate_delta
        comparator: ">"
        threshold: 0.02
        window: 5m
    action: rollback

  - name: soft-limit
    conditions:
      - metric: mrr_delta
        comparator: "<"
        threshold: -0.01
        window: 15m
    action: cap_traffic: 10%

  - name: latency-safety
    conditions:
      - metric: latency_p95_delta_ms
        comparator: ">"
        threshold: 50
        window: 5m
    action: divert_to_stable
```
Priya: One nit — keep a very short window (1m) for quick bounce detection using small-sample heuristics, but require 15m confirmation for persistent decisions. Also apply Farrington/low-count smoothing for sparse slices.
Jon: +1. Also enforce a minimum sample size per slice (suggest 1k requests) before any automatic rollback to reduce flakiness.
canary-bot: canary started: v3.2-lite-q4 -> 5% traffic.
Maya (SRE): I'll watch p95 and GPU lane exhaustion alerts — please set autoscale buffer to +1 to avoid noisy lat spikes during warmup. :thumbsup:
Samir: Thanks all. Plan: run 2h shadow first for longdoc embed drift, then flip 5% canary with the config above. Tagging SRE and Prod to stand by.
Priya: If we see small MRR blips but no hallucination or latency signals, prefer soft-limit instead of full rollback to gather more data.
Lena: I'll add a per-slice concordance check (semantic similarity on a 50-sample holdout) to the eval harness and surface that to the gate UI.
Jon: We'll capture full per-slice counts and a quick drift diff table in the canary report. If any slice shows >5% sample-weighted MRR loss, escalate to manual hold.
Samir: Cool — I'll update the rollout manifest and post when shadow run completes. :rocket:
